text: Debugging is a vital skill for any programmer. When you identify a bug, the first step is to understand the problem clearly before making random changes. A systematic approach, such as reproducing the error and isolating different parts of your code, saves a lot of time. Modern debugging tools, like breakpoints and step-by-step execution, are extremely helpful for inspecting what your program does at each moment. Additionally, logging is a powerful technique; by printing values or status messages to the console, you can track the flow of your logic. Remember, patience and a clear method are often more valuable than fast guesses.
